sacristan: ciarán ryan solemnity of all saints november 1st 2026 we remember in our prayer at mass this weekend the following whose anniversaries and month’s mind occur at this time: hannah & padraig kelly martin & patrica daly nancy ryan terry o’rourke sheridan kenny jack willis harry & hannah smyth wesley acres from the deacon’s desk solemnity of all saints revelation 7:2-4,9-14 & matthew 5:1-12a. the solemnity of all saints invites us to lift our eyes beyond the struggles of daily life and remember the countless men and women who have gone before us marked with the sign of faith. in the vision of the book of revelation, john beholds a vast multitude from every nation, race and language standing before the throne of god. they are ordinary people who remained faithful through trials and now share in the fullness of god's glory. in the gospel, jesus presents the beatitudes, a portrait of true holiness. the saints are not remembered because they were powerful, wealthy or successful by worldly standards. rather, they were poor in spirit, merciful, peacemakers, and people who hungered for righteousness. they allowed god's grace to shape their lives. this feast reminds us that holiness is not reserved for a select few. it is the calling of every christian. as we honour the saints, we are encouraged to follow their example, trusting that god continues to lead us along the path that ends in the joy of heaven. deacon eric rev eric cooney coordinator of parish administration mobile:
